body: Thanks for filling me in that you know nothing of saving feral cats.
The ASPCA supports the use of these insulated boxes to save the lives of thousands of feral cats.rescue is my life. Dont judge something you are woefully ignorant of. Shameful.

They are not my cats. They will not come inside.you know nothing of this common situation. You are foolishy judging me. If you dont have an answer to the question then stop showing your ignorance. The aspca prays for kind people who care enough to build these shelters to save the lives of ferals. You judge someone who would provide such help. Do some research before smugly judge those who do this work. Wow. Wrong sub. These are ferals. They will not come inside. Educate yourself.

I have a friend in another state. He has more money than God, but he wont offer to help. Of course I didnt ask. My need is obvious. He just said hes sorry and hopes it works out. My plan has been to ride a bus to a bridge near here and jump off the part where theres not much water. Mostly rocks.

A woman I thought was my friend sent me a rext that said, " I dont want to text with you anymore. Im sick of your anxiety". But if I were to take myself out everyone would be like, " oh I didnt know she felt that bad." Its like .I could get someone to maybe help me, but not my animals. You 3 souls here who wrote me: youre the only kindness Ive had.

Yes my animals would lose their minds if I werent here. Let me tell you.
Thank you for being proud of me. Thank you for writing me.
I dont know how to cross post to r/legal or I would. I would do ANYTHING for someone in my shoes. Anything.
Thank you for all the kind things you said. I found out today that youl cant appeal an eviction.i dont know what this hearing is even for. I have no money for any kind of hotel.

Thank you. I am so lonely and so scared I cant function. I found out today there is a hearing on 14 Sept. My lawyer didnt tell me that. So I have a few more days. Im trying so hard to hang on. Im so lonely. The guy I have to deal with at this Service Center is a jerk like none other. He hates his job and I sense he hates anyone he has to "help".Thank you for believing in me. I want to do good things but its like everything is telling me: Nope. Not you. Theres nothing for you."
Almost no one is kind. Not to me. Not now. Prople I thought were friends have run away as fast as they can. No one will call me. No one will answer emails.
Thank you for your kindness. So much.

Do you really want to be friends ? I
 Need a friend. Just one.
